calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset signal reversing recent three-day volatility-normalized shocks, smoothed over three completed sessions.

validation.regime_notes: Revalidation remains positive and clears the benchmark gates on non-overlapping 10-day observations; daily overlapping ICIR is conservative and below gate. Recent 365-day performance is strong, while 750-day stability is weaker. Small cross-section and missing dates require caution.

signal_provenance.method: Date-aligned cross-sectional Spearman IC across 15 tradable instruments, minimum 8 valid names; non-overlapping subsample reported for admission stability.
